Esta es la segunda competencia del año en Quiché y la novena competencia del año en Guatemala. Esta competencia consistirá únicamente de "eventos silenciosos".

This will be the second competition held in Quiché and the ninth competition held in Guatemala this year. The competition will consist exclusively of “quiet events.”
